abstract: Karotype and capacity for differentiation were determined in four transplantable teratomas, and their embryoid bodies, derived from C3H mouse embryos. An apparently normal karyotype was retained by one tumour and one subline that were able to differentiate into a wide range of tissues, but some chromosomal alterations were found in the two tumours and one subline that showed almost identical restrictions in their capacity for differentiation. Trisomy for chromosome 11 was shared by all three restricted tumours; two of the tumours had similar length changes in the same two chromosome (1 and 14) while the third was generally trisomic for four other chromosomes.
abstract_ja: C3Hマウス胚に由来する4種の移植可能なマウス奇形腫と、その胚様体の核型および分化能を検討した。1つの腫瘍と1つのサブラインは正常核型を保ち、広範な組織へ分化可能であった。一方、分化能が制限された3つの腫瘍は、いずれも第11染色体の三倍体を共通して有していた。2つの腫瘍は第1および第14染色体に類似の長さの変化を有し、3つ目の腫瘍は他の4染色体についても概ね三倍体であった。
